data.title: Bitcoin struggles above $80K as whale transfers signal mixed outlook
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin traded above $81,500, struggling to sustain a recovery as conflicting exchange flows and large whale transactions clouded the cryptocurrency’s near-term outlook, while institutional interest in blockchain technology continued to expand.
